verdict.rationale: Meilisearch docs explicitly describe a built-in analytics capability tracking search queries, click events, and conversions to measure search quality (docs-9, docs-29, docs-54), which covers query tracking and click-through, but there is no explicit mention of a dedicated 'no-result queries' report/dashboard and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the analytics feature's UI or accuracy. missing for 10: explicit no-result-query reporting, a documented dashboard/UI view of these metrics, independent user confirmation of the analytics feature in practice.
